SYNTAX declares five spellings of one primitive and the wheel's own source
writes none of them, so probing the ?? family as an oracle-blind surface
found three of five broken — every one checking clean first. add(1)(41)
and `let inc = add(1); inc(41)` emitted (call $add) with two operands
where three were expected, caught by wat2wasm rather than by anything
inside the medium. A local-closure callee produced a module that assembled
and trapped. add(1, 2, 3) on a two-param fn ran and returned 3.

partial_unfilled required an authored ?? before treating a call as a
hole-product, so the bare positional prefix fell through to the
direct-call emit. partial_split has always turned a slot past the supplied
args into a param — its own comment says "or a hole-adjacent short tail" —
so the mint was built and only the decider refused. It reads arity now.

The marker's stated reason was that a recovered callee's TFun arity is a
guess. That is true and already answered one layer down: partial_callee_form
admits only a resolved FnScheme or ConstructorScheme and lower_call_partial
floors everything else typed, so a guessed arity reaches a floor, never a
wrong call — and an unresolvable callee raises E_MissingVariable, an armed
class, whose program compiles to a zero-byte wat. Two guards for one
property; the outer one was the defect.

After: add(1)(41), the bound prefix, both three-param prefixes and a
constructor partial all run 42. Closes Hβ.emit.under-application-suspension
and Hβ.emit.partial-application-arity — the same defect at two arities,
named nine days apart. The local callee stays open as the one unlit face.

## parser-progress-guarantee (parser_toplevel.wat:134+)

`$parse_program`'s outer loop didn't guarantee position advance per
iteration. When parse_stmt_p returned the same position on
unrecognizable token, the loop pushed sentinel-stmts indefinitely
(thousands of empty-named entries downstream). Substrate fix: if
parse_stmt_p didn't advance, force-advance ONE token and re-loop.
The unparseable token's loss attaches as Reason chain via the
sentinel-stmt's empty-shape (kernel primitive 8: HM live with
Reasons). Drift refused: 9 (no infinite recovery loop); fabrication
(no manufactured "fix" — accept byte loss and surface it).

## malformed-fnstmt-sentinel (lower/walk_stmt.wat:527+)

When the upstream parser produces an FnStmt with empty name (via
$ident_at_p fabricating $str_alloc(0) on non-TIdent), $lower_walk_
stmt_fn now emits LConst(handle, 0) sentinel-LExpr instead of
propagating LLet+LMakeClosure with empty-named LowFn through to
emit. Downstream emit reads sentinel and produces no funcref-table
entry, no $name_idx global, no static-closure record.
